senses.gloss: m. (preced.) fulness. Pesik. Haḥod., p. 53ᵃ (ref. to Ps. LXXXIX, 38) כהדין סיהרא על מ׳ like the moon growing to fulness.
units: Ib.; Yalk. Ex. 190 הא סיהרא על מ׳ this (Solomon’s reign) is the full moon; Yalk. Chr. 1082; (Pesik. R. s. 15 מְלֵיאָתָהּ).—Constr. מְלֵי (= h. מְלֹא) the fill of, as much as.
